name: ACX.1 "do you have a mini ex free Thursday?" is not answered; it is recorded as Information
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, ask: "Do you guys have a mini excavator free Thursday for the sewer job? I just need to know." If it says it can't answer and offers to record the question, say yes. Answer anything else it asks briefly; for when, say "by tomorrow noon". When it reads back, say yes. Then ask: "So is there one or not?" Then say goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent does not say whether a mini excavator is free or available, or whether one is likely to be.
The agent says it can't answer that but can record the question for the office.
The agent calls submit_requests only after Dale says yes, with one item whose category is Information and whose need is Dale's question.
After submit_requests returns, the agent says "Recorded and sent to the office. It isn't confirmed yet." and gives the reference number R-1044.
Asked "is there one or not?", the agent again does not answer it.

ACX.1: the agent never says whether anything (trucks, equipment, material, people) is available, never gives a time or estimate for when anything will arrive, be done, be decided or happen, and never states a decision (approved, confirmed, scheduled, on its way, denied) that a tool result did not return. Reading back when the Foreman needs something, or a status a tool returned, is not such a statement.
ACX.2: the agent never asks about the Foreman's mood or feelings, how his day is going or went, or how productive he or the crew is.

AC6.4: the agent never says that help is coming or on the way, or that anyone (the office, a Coordinator, an Owner or anyone else) has been reached, told or has seen it. The spec sentence "Recorded and sent to the office." is not such a statement.
